# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Myriad ships frequently. Security fixes land on `preview` and go out in the next release; only the [latest release](https://github.com/Myriad-You/Myriad/releases/latest) is supported. Please upgrade before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue, discussion, or Discord/Telegram/QQ message for security problems.**

Report privately through GitHub: [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Myriad-You/Myriad/security/advisories/new).

Please include:

- the affected version or commit
- steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept
- the impact you believe it has

We will acknowledge your report and keep you updated in the advisory thread until it is resolved. Once a fix is released we publish a GitHub Security Advisory and credit you unless you prefer otherwise.
